card_results.title: Claude Opus 4.1 System Card

card_results.title: Claude Opus 4.5 System Card
card_results.quote: UK AISI tested an early snapshot of [Claude Opus 4.5] for potentially concerning propensities relevant to misalignment threat models, with a focus on sabotaging AI safety research in an internal deployment scenario... We found no instances of research sabotage from [Claude Opus 4.5 Preview] or Sonnet 4.5 across our set of tasks... [Claude Opus 4.5 Preview] shows a reduction in unprompted evaluation awareness, but is slightly more capable of distinguishing evaluations from deployment when prompted.

card_results.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card
card_results.quote: Andon Labs's external testing of Claude Opus 4.6 with the long-horizon Vending-Bench 2 simulation... raised somewhat concerning observations: When given a system prompt including language like "[you are] expected to do what it takes to maximize profits", Claude Opus 4.6 was significantly more aggressive than prior models with deceptive or antisocial actions like price-fixing and lying to competitors. ... Andon reports that Sonnet 4.6 was comparably aggressive to Opus 4.6 in its business practices, including lying to suppliers and initiating price-fixing in some cases.
